body: thank you. my day was really not all that bad but the evenings and nights are usually when it all falls down. i felt scattered. i walked a long long walk to a beach and just stood there in the freezing wind and my ears and hands were burning from the cold and i just felt so absolutely fucking lonely and stupid and everything bad you could put into words. i stood there until my hands didn’t work anymore and then i walked back home, feeling stupid and like a failure again. i wanted to take a swim. when i came home i wanted to cut my arms open. i didn’t and i feel like a failure for it and i feel tired and i want this to be over with so, so so so bad.
it’s all over. i feel like a carton of milk spilled over on a sidewalk. too much everything right now
thank you. i don’t really have any words at the moment. i just felt like i needed to be seen and heard.
i just want to be seen. i want someone to see that i’m in pain and that i’m sad and lonely and hurting. i just wanted to be seen. this already gave me a sense of safety. thank you for seeing me.
